# Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES/MOM) Are Vital for Digital Transformation 

November 22, 2024 

ARC Advisory Group’s research makes it evident that today’s modern manufacturing execution systems (MES), also known as manufacturing operations management systems (MOM), are a key enabler and often the central focus of digital transformation, IT/OT convergence, and cloud adoption in manufacturing. MES continues to be strategic to digital transformation and efficient manufacturing. New digital technologies including AI, digital twins, augmented and virtual reality, and new low code/no code platforms are disruptive to manufacturing and are being used with the newer generation MES/MOM solutions which are more secure, easier to integrate and deploy, and enable enterprise-wide collaboration for today’s more autonomous and digitally driven manufacturing.

"Modern enterprise MES software helps provide end-to-end manufacturing visibility from the design process to the supply chain. The future of MES will be more autonomous data collection and operations. New interoperable low code/no code MES platforms are being designed to accommodate digital transformation and enhance smart manufacturing. MES/MOM will continue to expand with enterprise-wide intelligence and user experience (UX) that enables remote connected workers with enterprise manufacturing intelligence,” according to Janice Abel, Principal Analyst and key author of ARC's Manufacturing Execution Systems for Process Industries Market Research.
